body:
Configured the live Stalwart instance end to end via Playwright driving the real admin UI (no verified safe headless/API path existed). Domain carepyre.org: enabled, Automatic DKIM (RSA+Ed25519 keys generated), ACME TLS via a new Let's Encrypt provider. Real, live correction found: Stalwart's DNS Providers feature is RFC2136/TSIG only, not native Cloudflare REST API -- EMAIL_NORTHSTAR.md and STALWART_PROVISIONING_REPORT.md corrected. ops/stalwart/terraform/dns.tf now owns the full real record set (A/MX/SPF/DKIM x2/DMARC), all 5 applied and confirmed live via Cloudflare API. Four real accounts created: brian@carepyre.org (aliases hello@/contact@), penelope@carepyre.org, gary@carepyre.org, emily@carepyre.org, each with a unique generated password handed to the founder out of band. New docs/STALWART_RUNBOOK.md documents the full human-repeatable sequence including every real bug found (DKIM checkbox default, alias Local-Part/Description field mixup, config.json bare-directory crash-loop, install.sh re-run bug, fail2ban self-trip). Known gaps named honestly: no postmaster@carepyre.org mailbox, TLS cert issuance timing unconfirmed, no IDUNA integration. CarePyre commit 78c56d0.

⚓ ☃
title: Stalwart mail server: domain, DKIM, ACME, DNS, and 4 accounts live
